description: Allowed predicates for the NLC concept ontology. Edge class path = fine composition/sequence; summary = coarse fact that may expand into a path.

path.description: Ordered fine steps or part-whole composition. Shown when drilling into a summary edge.

summary.description: Coarse relationship true because a path exists (or asserted for docs). May declare expanded_by or expanded_as_path.

predicates.description: Whole contains part (Goal comprises Atomic action).
Atomic action binds to a codified constraint / rule / ADR obligation.
Constraint is bound onto an atomic action.
Strict sequence: step A immediately precedes step B on the compile spine.
Gate/audit outcome permits the next step (weaker than precedes when refusal is possible).
Emit/generate produces an artifact (e.g. Produced code).
Artifact or plan is subject to an adversarial audit step.
Source constraint document yields an exact quote.
Exact quote becomes a codified constraint (data type + if/then).
Coarse: ADR / rule / pack constrains produced code or a goal.
Coarse produces (Goal produces Produced code). Prefer expanded_by to the fine path.
Coarse: Goal is bound by an ADR or requirement pack.
Hyper-style: Goal + ADR/codified constraints together realize Produced code. Use a bundle node or reified edge record.
Participant belongs to a realization / bundle node.
Realization bundle node outputs Produced code.
A subject requires a named peer. A bad pairing refuses (durable workflow requires an engine).
A harness may write files. Those files are still Produced code and still go through verify.

rules: Every summary edge in a published diagram MUST set expanded_by (edge ids) or expanded_as_path (node ids), OR asserted_without_path: true (docs-only, rare).
path edges claiming the FEATURES compile spine MUST NOT skip required spine steps (Goal → Atomic action → Bind → Reverse adversarial audit → Emit → Produced code → Code adversarial audit).
Do not invent hops: ontology may declare allowed types; runtime instance graphs only write recorded ids.
predicate produces on class path is fine-grained (Emit → code); summary Goal → code uses produces_summary or a realizes bundle.
